name: images_generate
description: Generate/edit images. No refs=TTI. references[] (max 12; see field docs). Output is opaque (no alpha); for transparent/cutout background, chain `images_remove_background` after. Defaults: mode=auto, ratio=1:1, count<=8. resolution/quality per images_models_list. UI clients: after generating, MUST call `creations_show` with all identifiers; never stop at links.

brandKitId.description: Optional. Brand kit sqid (the `id` from brand_kit_list/brand_kit_get). When set, the image is generated on-brand: brand palette, logo, typography and reference imagery are applied automatically.

templateSlug.description: Optional. Content template `slug` from the kit (brand_kit_get.templates); requires brandKitId. Applies that content type's prompt-ready description.

mode.description: Model `slug` from images_models_list. User named a model/family/provider → resolve to its slug (never 'auto'). Omit/'auto' only if no model preference.

type.description: image = any photo you have, incl. of a person/product to keep consistent. character/product/locations = pre-built library asset, never a creation. style = library LoRA, or a creation as style photo.

identifier.description: creation identifier for image/style-photo; numeric `id` from library_list for character/product/locations/style-LoRA. Upload URLs first.

resolution.description: Optional. Supported values per model — see `images_models_list.resolutions`. Omitted values use the model default.

quality.description: Optional. Supported values per model — see `images_models_list.qualities`. Omitted values use the model default.

folderReference.description: Optional project/folder reference from `folders_list` to place results in. Omit for the default.
